The '''Red Light Lancers''' were an organization of tech specialists on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were a sub-organization of the bigger [[Guiding Hand]]. They were composed of many [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] and were based in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]].<ref name="RWTL" />
